name: Far East Hospitality Trust
summary: Far East Hospitality Trust is a Singapore-Focused Hotel and Serviced Residence Hospitality Trust listed on the Main Board of The Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited. Comprising Far East Hospitality Real Estate Investment Trust (Far East H-REIT) and Far East Hospitality Business Trust (Far East H-BT), Far East H-Trust was listed on the SGX-ST on 27 August 2012 and has a portfolio of 13 properties totaling 3,334 hotel rooms and serviced residence units valued at approximately S2.56 billion dollars as at 31 December 2025.
